Metric tracking

What we track and optimize

Every entry is structured, analyzed, and synthesized into clinical insights for your medical team.

Dosing & titration

Maintains optimal therapeutic levels while minimizing side effects.

  • Logs exact injection timestamp and dose strength (for example 2.5mg, 5.0mg, 7.5mg).
  • Prompts injection site rotation to prevent localized fat tissue changes.
  • Alerts you if a dose is delayed or missed, with guided recovery instructions approved by your provider.
  • Tracks side-effect severity over time to help your doctor decide if you are ready to titrate up or hold your current dose.

Lean mass preservation

Ensures weight loss is fat loss, not lean muscle mass.

  • Calculates daily protein goals based on lean body mass (typically 1.2g to 2.0g per kg).
  • Logs food entries in seconds using natural language (for example “6oz chicken breast and a cup of quinoa”).
  • Provides real-time feedback on amino acid completeness and protein distribution across meals.
  • Integrates with resistance training logs so muscles receive the stimulus and fuel they need.

Hydration & electrolytes

Prevents headaches, supports kidney function, and maintains energy.

  • Calculates dynamic fluid goals from body weight, activity level, and local weather.
  • Sends non-intrusive electrolyte reminders, especially on injection day and the 48 hours following.
  • Tracks hydration consistency to prevent common GLP-1 side effects like mild headaches, fatigue, and constipation.
  • Helps you monitor fluid retention alongside scale weight to isolate true body-composition progress.

Biomarkers & symptoms

Aggregates daily vitals and subjective logs for clinical review.

  • Logs daily weight with a 7-day moving average to smooth water-weight fluctuations.
  • Tracks blood pressure, resting heart rate, sleep duration, and subjective energy.
  • Monitors digestive health and flags persistent mild symptoms with validated lifestyle remedies.
  • Compiles metrics into structured clinical reports synced to your patient profile for your doctor’s review.
The telehealth gap

Traditional telehealth vs. novimid continuous care

Why standard online clinics fail to maintain long-term results, and how the continuous care engine solves it.

Key care pillar Traditional telehealth novimid continuous care
Support cadence Once every 4–12 weeks during brief follow-up appointments. 24/7/365 continuous accountability with sub-15-second response times.
Dose & adherence Patient relies on memory; missed doses or incorrect titration are common. Proactive, calendar-synced dose tracking with automated site rotation prompts.
Body composition Focuses solely on scale weight; high risk of muscle loss (up to 40% of total loss). Strict focus on lean mass preservation with automated protein and resistance training tracking.
Symptom management Minor side effects go unmanaged, leading to premature treatment discontinuation. Real-time clinical triage and lifestyle guidance to resolve mild symptoms quickly.
Provider visibility Doctors make decisions based on retrospective, often inaccurate patient recall. Doctors receive structured, objective quarterly biomarker reports before your visit.
Clinical integrity & safety

Strict medical guardrails and triage protocols

The AI Accountability Coach supports, not replaces, human clinical judgment. It operates under guardrails established by the medical team, including Dr. Wasef and Dr. Sakla.

Red-flag triage

If you report severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, or heart palpitations, the AI stops the session, provides emergency instructions, and alerts clinical staff.

Locked knowledge base

The AI is bound to peer-reviewed clinical literature, endocrinology standards, and provider-approved guidelines. It does not pull unverified advice from the open web.

HIPAA-compliant sync

Conversations and logged metrics are encrypted. Vitals and symptoms are compiled and integrated into your patient electronic health record.

Physician remains in charge

The coach cannot prescribe, diagnose, or change your plan. Dose adjustments stay with your licensed novimid physician.
